description: Create a fixed-price product (Matanot) for the rikma. Three hosting modes (PLAN_USER_OFFERINGS §3.3): `projectId` alone → the product lives on that rikma (caller must be a member); without it → personal offer hosted on the caller’s home rikma (origin=personal); `newRikmaName` → a fresh named rikma is created first and hosts it. Use it for the storefront: name, description, price, stock (quant, -1 = unlimited), kindOf (total/monthly/yearly/daily/unlimited), location, and an uploaded image id (picId). For a complex recipe (BOM, margin, estimated price) use createComplexMatanot in the UI — the MCP creates the simple, shippable shelf item. Members or personal owner. Returns the new Matanot id and where it lives. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#createRikmaProductTool

descrip.description: Long description shown to the buyer.

kindOf.description: How price×quantity is understood. Default total.

location.description: Where the product is (or isOnline:true via location_mode online).

name.description: Product name — shown in the catalog and on the /gift page.

newRikmaName.description: Create a fresh rikma with this name and host the product there. Not combined with projectId.

picId.description: Strapi upload id of the cover image.

price.description: Fixed price in the rikma currency (or the currency code you pass).

pricingMode.description: fixed = sold at this price (checkout:true, what the storefront reports), estimated = shown as estimate, quote = price on request. Default fixed.

projectId.description: Host it on this rikma (you must be a member). Omit for a personal offer on your home rikma.

quant.description: Available quantity: a number, -1 for unlimited, or omit for 0.

name: createRikmaProductTool
